title: Data Description
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
#| file: functions.R
```

```{r erg-full}

library(DBI)
library(dm)
library(dplyr)
library(gapindex)
library(DiagrammeR)
library(here)

# 1. Establish Oracle Connection
con <- con_products

# 2. Target Schema Tables (18 tables)
target_tables <- c(
  "ENVIRONMENTAL", "DIRECTION_CODES", "INSTRUMENT_CODES", "VARIABLE_CODES", 
  "HAUL", "CRUISE", "CPUE", "BIOMASS", "SIZECOMP", "AGECOMP", "AREA", 
  "SURVEY_DESIGN", "STRATUM_GROUPS", "SPECIES_YEAR", "TAXON_GROUPS", 
  "LENGTH", "SPECIMEN", "TAXONOMIC_CLASSIFICATION"
)

# 3. Load Schema
gap_products_erd <- dm_from_con(
  con,
  table_names = target_tables,
  learn_keys = FALSE
)

# 4. Primary Keys (Defined on true parent entities to keep table layouts unified)
gap_products_erd <- gap_products_erd |>
  # Operational / Event Hierarchy
  dm_add_pk(CRUISE, CRUISEJOIN) |>
  dm_add_pk(HAUL, HAULJOIN) |>
  
  # Taxonomy Parent
  dm_add_pk(TAXONOMIC_CLASSIFICATION, SPECIES_CODE) |>
  
  # Geographic & Design Parents
  dm_add_pk(SURVEY_DESIGN, SURVEY_DEFINITION_ID) |>
  dm_add_pk(AREA, AREA_ID) |>
  dm_add_pk(STRATUM_GROUPS, STRATUM) |>
  
  # Measurement Lookups
  dm_add_pk(DIRECTION_CODES, DIRECTION) |>
  dm_add_pk(INSTRUMENT_CODES, INSTRUMENT) |>
  dm_add_pk(VARIABLE_CODES, VARIABLE)

# 5. Foreign Keys (Relational mappings)
gap_products_erd <- gap_products_erd |>
  # Event Hierarchy (HAUL -> CRUISE)
  dm_add_fk(table = HAUL, columns = CRUISEJOIN, ref_table = CRUISE) |>
  
  # Haul-level Sampling Data -> HAUL
  dm_add_fk(table = ENVIRONMENTAL, columns = HAULJOIN, ref_table = HAUL) |>
  dm_add_fk(table = CPUE, columns = HAULJOIN, ref_table = HAUL) |>
  dm_add_fk(table = LENGTH, columns = HAULJOIN, ref_table = HAUL) |>
  dm_add_fk(table = SPECIMEN, columns = HAULJOIN, ref_table = HAUL) |>
  
  # Environmental Measurement Lookups
  dm_add_fk(table = ENVIRONMENTAL, columns = DIRECTION, ref_table = DIRECTION_CODES) |>
  dm_add_fk(table = ENVIRONMENTAL, columns = INSTRUMENT, ref_table = INSTRUMENT_CODES) |>
  dm_add_fk(table = ENVIRONMENTAL, columns = VARIABLE, ref_table = VARIABLE_CODES) |>
  
  # Biological Data -> TAXONOMIC_CLASSIFICATION
  dm_add_fk(table = CPUE, columns = SPECIES_CODE, ref_table = TAXONOMIC_CLASSIFICATION) |>
  dm_add_fk(table = LENGTH, columns = SPECIES_CODE, ref_table = TAXONOMIC_CLASSIFICATION) |>
  dm_add_fk(table = SPECIMEN, columns = SPECIES_CODE, ref_table = TAXONOMIC_CLASSIFICATION) |>
  dm_add_fk(table = TAXON_GROUPS, columns = SPECIES_CODE, ref_table = TAXONOMIC_CLASSIFICATION) |>
  dm_add_fk(table = SPECIES_YEAR, columns = SPECIES_CODE, ref_table = TAXONOMIC_CLASSIFICATION) |>
  dm_add_fk(table = AGECOMP, columns = SPECIES_CODE, ref_table = TAXONOMIC_CLASSIFICATION) |>
  dm_add_fk(table = BIOMASS, columns = SPECIES_CODE, ref_table = TAXONOMIC_CLASSIFICATION) |>
  dm_add_fk(table = SIZECOMP, columns = SPECIES_CODE, ref_table = TAXONOMIC_CLASSIFICATION) |>
  
  # Geographic Links -> AREA
  dm_add_fk(table = STRATUM_GROUPS, columns = AREA_ID, ref_table = AREA) |>
  dm_add_fk(table = SIZECOMP, columns = AREA_ID, ref_table = AREA) |>
  dm_add_fk(table = AGECOMP, columns = AREA_ID, ref_table = AREA) |>
  dm_add_fk(table = BIOMASS, columns = AREA_ID, ref_table = AREA) |>
  
  # Design Links -> SURVEY_DESIGN
  dm_add_fk(table = AREA, columns = SURVEY_DEFINITION_ID, ref_table = SURVEY_DESIGN) |>
  dm_add_fk(table = CRUISE, columns = SURVEY_DEFINITION_ID, ref_table = SURVEY_DESIGN)

# 6. Apply Thematic Domain Colors
gap_products_erd <- gap_products_erd |>
  dm_set_colors(
    "#fcacf9" = c(HAUL, CPUE, SPECIMEN, LENGTH),
    "#E2F0D9" = c(TAXONOMIC_CLASSIFICATION, TAXON_GROUPS, SPECIES_YEAR),
    "#fcd4ac" = c(AGECOMP, SIZECOMP, BIOMASS),
    "#fcacac" = c(CRUISE, SURVEY_DESIGN, AREA, STRATUM_GROUPS),
    "#acc3fc" = c(ENVIRONMENTAL, DIRECTION_CODES, INSTRUMENT_CODES, VARIABLE_CODES)
  )

# 7. Render Base Diagram with All Columns
draw_obj <- dm_draw(
  gap_products_erd, 
  view_type = "all"
)

# 8. Post-Process DOT String
dot_str <- draw_obj$val$graph$s

# A. Force Horizontal Layout (rankdir="LR"), set node/rank spacing, and global font
dot_str <- gsub(
  'graph \\[', 
  'graph [ rankdir="LR", fontname="Arial", nodesep="0.8", ranksep="2.0", node [fontname="Arial"], edge [fontname="Arial"], ', 
  dot_str
)

# B. Override hardcoded HTML node fonts to Arial
dot_str <- gsub('face="[^"]*"', 'face="Arial"', dot_str)
dot_str <- gsub('FONT FACE="[^"]*"', 'FONT FACE="Arial"', dot_str)

# C. Global Underline Injection for Key Attributes
keys_to_underline <- c("SURVEY_DEFINITION_ID", "CRUISEJOIN", "HAULJOIN", "SPECIES_CODE", "AREA_ID", "STRATUM")

for (key in keys_to_underline) {
  pattern <- paste0('(?<!<U>)', key, '(?!</U>)')
  replacement <- paste0('<U>', key, '</U>')
  dot_str <- gsub(pattern, replacement, dot_str, perl = TRUE)
}

# Assign updated DOT string back
draw_obj$val$graph$s <- dot_str

# 9. Export to SVG
svg_diagram <- DiagrammeRsvg::export_svg(draw_obj)

writeLines(svg_diagram, here::here("content/gap_products_erd.svg"))
# Open 'environmental_erd.svg' directly in your browser!

```


